title: Snapshot entrance illustration set and interactive step schematic
creator: Maya Chen
description: Deliver a compact, modular illustration system and an interactive step schematic for the Quickstart landing experience. Aim is to replace the existing large hero with a snapshot-style entrance that surfaces 3 progressive onboarding steps, a live sample panel, and contextual microcopy. The deliverables must include: 1) a Figma component kit with light/dark tokens and responsive constraints, 2) annotated redlines for engineering (SVG export specs and spacing tokens), 3) 3 hero permutations for persona-driven copy (developer, platform engineer, enterprise admin), and 4) three staged screenshots for the docs release notes and marketplace listing. Designs must align with recent brand refresh tokens and be optimized for both desktop 1280px and a compact mobile breakpoint 360px.
acceptance_criteria: Figma component file published in the Redwood Design org with versioned components and usage notes
Exported PNG/SVG assets for hero and step tiles at 1x/2x for both light and dark themes
Annotated redlines document with spacing, font sizes, color tokens, and accessibility contrast checks
Three persona-ready hero variations with copy approved by PM and localization-ready strings
Engineers have a tracked PR to integrate screenshots and SVGs with proper responsive CSS classes
